description: An important part of every mission is designing and collaborating what the next step of humanity is. What to accomplish next, but there remains a space open for how to get there and where restraints are. To be able to create a tool that can help aid future missions is something that would be rather useful. Not just for an agency but for all humanity.
summary: In this short piece of fiction, it displays a fictional story about the rover Opportunity and how it comes to senses with what its reason for creation may be. Opportunity is lost, hence the name, on how it should go about its values of its duty and what it may really want to do, breaking out of the system it was built by. It may allow readers to connect with the rover on experiences they might have had. With connection, it can allow for further interest in the topic of Opportunity & Spirit along with other rovers.
details: It incoorperates ideas that connects human experiences which can be by interpretations into a NASA rover's thoughts. Though it's fictional, it's meant to provide it's readers with a sense of sympathy for a rover which is something typically built for a single use and soon discarded. This being a life no one should go through, though many may resonate with it whether it be big or small events in one's life. The story uses references to the actual mission regarding Opportunity & Spirit along with ways they can fictionally communicate.
